preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 2 and 100,000.
The number of roads m must be between n-1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_i <= n and 1 <= y_i <= n and x_i != y_i for x_i, y_i in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect two distinct cities within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n-1 integers, one for each destination city except the starting city.

postconditions.expression: all(int(num) % (10**9 + 7) == int(num) for num in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Each output number must be the remainder of the smallest possible number modulo 10^9+7.
